headline: What I built - a proof of concept for suspicious email classification aimed at scam emails: Scam Signal Lens.

media.alt: Video from the post by Danny Livshits

text: I was exploring Jev by @typesafeai  AI for safety use cases and it is an impressive and useful model, however don't expect it to magically auto classify any data without proper parameters and thresholds (see finding below). I open-sourced a scam-email classification where you can…
